name: Egervölgy (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and red at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egervölgy (a crowned red and white shield with bars and a tree) above the name EGERVÖLGY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
